title: Monsoon Picnic Fellowship
summary: The club decided for a Monsoon picnic after a successful and hectic Installation of New Regal Team in July 2026 and other meetings. The idea was to bring about a Cheer and bonding.
description: The club decided for a Monsoon picnic after a successful and hectic Installation of New Regal Team in July 2026 and other meetings. The idea was to bring about a Cheer and bonding. Rtn Prakash arranged for a River front Venue of Radio club. Rotarians and Annes 26 in number traveled by Bus singing songs and eating snacks and cold drinks. The view was beautiful from the Radio club. The fellowship started with President thanking all for Joining the Picnic and called for serving Snacks and Drinks. Rtn Hitesh Somaiya conducted Tambola also known as Housie or Indian Bingo which was thoroughly enjoyed by all. After sumptuous lunch and brief discussions on some projects and Club matters the Team was Invited for High Tea and Snacks by Charter Member Rtn Karunakar. The day ended with a joy ride in the bus back with songs and dance.
